metadata.title: Co-op Sponsor Check
metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Your Turn cut for concision (TA feedback 2026-10-21: concise pitch). show-tell style: opens on the hesitant writer + terms card, no verdict card; Your Turn is the composer; spoken outro stays (with the student's name, per the assignment).
metadata.audience: INFO 7375 instructor and TAs; later, hiring managers for software developer roles

skin_warnings: BNAME: palette=claude but the cold open is 'BrutalistHesitantWriter' — COLD OPEN LAW wants ClaudeComposerAsk

beats.narration_text: Hello. I'm Arundhati Kandelkar, a master's student at Northeastern.
beats.motion_claim: My name and programme type in while I say them.

qc.sparse_reason: Name card: the name is the whole picture.

beats.narration_text: I'm building Co-op Sponsor Check: a tool that tells international students whether a company has ever sponsored someone for a software job.

show.event: types 'I'm building Co-op Sponsor Check' as it is spoken

beats.motion_claim: The one-sentence summary types in as it is spoken.

qc.sparse_reason: One-sentence summary card.

beats.narration_text: When international students like me pick an internship, we need to know one thing: has this company ever sponsored someone for a software job? Today we guess, and a missing record looks like a no. My tool says I don't know, instead of guessing no.

show.event: corrects 'sponsor visas' to the narrower question

props.replacementWords: have a record of sponsoring software jobs

beats.motion_claim: The naive question is corrected to the one a tool can answer.

qc.sparse_reason: Hesitant-writer bookend: the correction is the motion.

beats.narration_text: When it's done, it will be a public GitHub repository: the tool, a twenty-five company evaluation set, and a log of where it fails.

shot.visual_intent: A repository folder tray holding three things: the company box (the tool), a small grid (the evaluation set), a page (the failure log); tag 'PLANNED · finished form'.
shot.motion_claim: A repository folder tray holding three things: the company box (the tool), a small grid (the evaluation set), a page (the failure log); tag 'PLANNED · finished form'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Here is what exists today. On October third I pushed a recipe to my fork of the Reallocation Engine. It takes a company and the job I want, software or full-stack development.

shot.visual_intent: A kraft company box drops onto the stage beside a flat data page; tag 'EXISTS · 03784b0'.
shot.motion_claim: A kraft company box drops onto the stage beside a flat data page; tag 'EXISTS · 03784b0'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: For each company it checks three things. Is there a record of sponsoring software titles? Does the co-op start before graduation? And is the job posting still live?

shot.visual_intent: The box opens; a record page, a calendar block and a check rise out of it, one per question.
shot.motion_claim: The box opens; a record page, a calendar block and a check rise out of it, one per question.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: When a company is missing from the data, it does not treat that as zero. It says unknown, and tells you to ask a person.

shot.visual_intent: A box rides up to a gate; the gate shows a question mark, never a zero.
shot.motion_claim: A box rides up to a gate; the gate shows a question mark, never a zero.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Building it, I found its biggest limit. The big banks were not in the dataset at all, because it was built from a list of funded startups taken from S E C filings.

shot.visual_intent: A data page with a gap; three bank boxes drop toward it and pass through the gap.
shot.motion_claim: A data page with a gap; three bank boxes drop toward it and pass through the gap.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Eighteen tests pass today: six failure cases, plus a new test for a bug the evaluation found.

shot.visual_intent: A tray of eighteen small slots; each gets a check; tag 'EXISTS · 18 / 18 · 2026-10-24'.
shot.motion_claim: A tray of eighteen small slots; each gets a check; tag 'EXISTS · 18 / 18 · 2026-10-24'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: The real alternative is the official U S C I S, H-1B Employer Data Hub. Searched on October twelfth, it does list JPMorgan Chase, which my dataset is missing. But it is searched one employer at a time, by name, place or industry, not by job title.

shot.visual_intent: A search window with a query bar and one result row; beside it a 'job title' filter pill gets crossed out; tag 'SEARCHED · uscis.gov · 2026-10-12'.
shot.motion_claim: A search window with a query bar and one result row; beside it a 'job title' filter pill gets crossed out; tag 'SEARCHED · uscis.gov · 2026-10-12'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: And a search for Mellon returned four employers: three B N Y companies, and Carnegie Mellon University. My tool will check a whole list for software titles and co-op dates, and it already has a test that refuses a match on part of a name.

shot.visual_intent: The four names the hub returned for 'Mellon', in its order; the three BNY rows get kraft markers, Carnegie Mellon gets a cross.
shot.motion_claim: The four names the hub returned for 'Mellon', in its order; the three BNY rows get kraft markers, Carnegie Mellon gets a cross.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Now, what will exist. A second public data source, to fill that gap, so a missing bank becomes a real answer or an honest unknown.

shot.visual_intent: A second page slides under the gapped page and fills the hole; tag 'PLANNED'.
shot.motion_claim: A second page slides under the gapped page and fills the hole; tag 'PLANNED'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Then I tested it on twenty-five companies. Every company I looked up in the official hub was there. My tool found a record for only two. It never guessed no. But that number told me something was wrong.

shot.visual_intent: A grid of twenty-five company squares; the first six fill grey and their rows land in the results table; the rest stay empty; tag '6 RAN · 2026-10-12 · 19 PLANNED'.

show.event: six squares fill, six rows land

shot.motion_claim: A grid of twenty-five company squares; the first six fill grey and their rows land in the results table; the rest stay empty; tag '6 RAN · 2026-10-12 · 19 PLANNED'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Two real problems. First, my matcher turned Goldman Sachs and Co, L L C, into Goldman Sachs and. It is fixed now, with a test that failed before the fix and passes after.

shot.visual_intent: The hub's name 'GOLDMAN SACHS AND CO LLC', an arrow, and the matcher's output 'GOLDMAN SACHS' with a tick; tag 'FIXED · 2026-10-24'.
shot.motion_claim: The hub's name 'GOLDMAN SACHS AND CO LLC', an arrow, and the matcher's output 'GOLDMAN SACHS' with a tick; tag 'FIXED · 2026-10-24'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Second, brand names. Typing Robinhood found nothing, but my data holds Robinhood Markets, with eight hundred and twenty-four approvals. Chime, and So Fi, failed the same way. That is the next fix.

shot.visual_intent: A typed name 'Robinhood' leads to a question mark; beside it, the dataset row 'ROBINHOOD MARKETS INC · 824' it missed; tag 'FOUND · 2026-10-25'.
shot.motion_claim: A typed name 'Robinhood' leads to a question mark; beside it, the dataset row 'ROBINHOOD MARKETS INC · 824' it missed; tag 'FOUND · 2026-10-25'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: So the risk that could sink this is names, and my test proved it. B N Y Mellon, and The Bank of New York Mellon, may be one employer or two. The tool will not guess. It will show the likely legal names to a person, who decides.

shot.visual_intent: One box with two name tags pulling in different directions; a 'human check' stamp lands between them.
shot.motion_claim: One box with two name tags pulling in different directions; a 'human check' stamp lands between them.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: One thing it will deliberately not do: give immigration advice, or predict whether anyone gets a visa. It reports history.

shot.visual_intent: A stop sign beside the box; three small label tags clip onto the box.
shot.motion_claim: A stop sign beside the box; three small label tags clip onto the box.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: What does it prove? Verification: every answer is labelled as a record, a judgment, or your input. Evaluation: twenty-five answers were checked against the official hub. Source grounding: every sponsor record in the run log cites its C S V line.

shot.visual_intent: Three trays in a row, labelled verification, evaluation, source grounding: label tags on a box; a ticked six-row table; a page with a line pointer; tag 'WHAT IT PROVES'.

show.event: a terracotta dot lands on each

shot.motion_claim: Three trays in a row, labelled verification, evaluation, source grounding: label tags on a box; a ticked six-row table; a page with a line pointer; tag 'WHAT IT PROVES'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Who opens it? A hiring manager or engineer hiring software developers. In the first minute, they will run one command, and see a report that says unknown where the data is silent, next to a table of where the tool was right and wrong.

shot.visual_intent: A laptop window: a terminal line, then a report with a question mark row and a small right/wrong table; tag 'CONSTRUCTED'.
shot.motion_claim: A laptop window: a terminal line, then a report with a question mark row and a small right/wrong table; tag 'CONSTRUCTED'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Why this project? It's my own question. I'm an international student, and this is what I face when choosing a co-op.

shot.visual_intent: The company box beside a calendar block, with a large question mark above the box; tag 'WHY THIS PROJECT'.
shot.motion_claim: The company box beside a calendar block, with a large question mark above the box; tag 'WHY THIS PROJECT'.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carrying the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: So it's a mix. I already build Java and Spring Boot services. I did it for three years as a software developer at G plus D, but this project doesn't show that. What's new for me is joining a second public data source into a small Python tool.

shot.visual_intent: Two trays: 'already have' with greyed blocks, labelled Giesecke+Devrient; 'new' with the second data page sliding in.

show.event: second page into the new tray

shot.motion_claim: Two trays: 'already have' with greyed blocks, labelled Giesecke+Devrient; 'new' with the second data page sliding in.
